description: Ten real-world floor plans run through the image -> model -> OI flow to test extraction robustness across styles, densities, and dimension styles.

entries.notes: Hand-drawn single bedroom on grid paper. Metric furniture dims plus a 5cm=1m scale bar.
Clean vector-style house diagram with a numbered legend (courts, porch, altar, storage). No metric dims.
Single-room event seating layout. Minimal geometry: one rectangle, no walls/doors drawn.
Dense CAD institutional floor at 1:100 with room tags. High room count stress case.
Palace ring plan at 1:500 with 100+ tiny furnished rooms. Extreme complexity ceiling case.
Czech site plan: five buildings (I-V), dashed demolition lines, stairs. Multi-region case.
entries.source: File:Areal Domu cp 332 Kamenicky Senov ul 9 kvetna.png

entries.notes: Event venue floor with labeled rooms (Main Hall, lobbies, baths). English labels, no dims.
entries.source: File:All Hands 2019 Bently Reserve First Floor.png

entries.notes: Richly dimensioned metric prison plan (0-130m figures) with 100+ cells. Site-extraction + scale case. Source is SVG, rasterized to PNG.
entries.source: File:Barnimstrasse women's prison cell layout-dimensions-functions in Berlin.svg

entries.notes: Hand-sketched rental room in pen/highlighter with closet + bath and feet/inches dims.
Superposed archaeological phases (first building in black, current in teal). Ambiguity case.

name: floorplan-web-10
scaleNote: Scale is a fixed TEST assumption (18x14 m footprint, 2.7 m height), applied only when the model reports no site. It is not the real size of any building here.
